sentences.en: Americans descend from immigrants, and they are very patriotic.
sentences.zh: 美国人来自移民，他们非常爱国。

sentences.en: The residents of this town are deeply religious and patriotic people.
sentences.zh: 这个镇上的居民是虔诚且爱国的人。

sentences.en: The film is dedicated to the veterans of the Great Patriotic War.
sentences.zh: 这部电影献给伟大卫国战争中的老兵们。

senses.zh: 爱国的，有爱国心的,爱国主义的
